scenarios.description: The trigger phrase is interpolated into a JMESPath string literal, so an apostrophe would break the expression. The field's safeExpressionLiteral constraint rejects it before any request is made. Without that constraint the service returns 422 with: Bad jmespath expression: Unknown token.
